hacks: Recruiters care about what you achieved, not just what you were assigned.
Swap "served customers" for "managed peak shift operations cleanly".
Mentioning software proves you have real digital skills for office roles.
Add systems like Excel, Teams or stock software to your descriptions.
Handling cash or society budgets shows financial trust and responsibility.
Write "managed committee budget" instead of "kept track of receipts".
Training peers or opening a store shows leadership without a manager title.
Use verbs like "trained", "led", or "coordinated" for team tasks.
Combining short promo or hospitality gigs keeps your CV clean and focused.
Group short gigs under one heading like "Event and Hospitality Work".
